about_blocks.text: Irving House Addiction Treatment Centre was founded with the goal of providing high-quality treatment for men struggling with addiction. Currently, the occupancy ranges from 6-15 individuals, with a focus on creating a small, intimate community for recovery. The primary language spoken at the center is English, and the facility currently holds no accreditations.

The primary language spoken at the center is English, and the facility currently holds no accreditations.

about_blocks.text: The center specializes in treating alcohol addiction, but our services extend to those who are struggling with a wide range of substance abuse issues. This includes benzodiazepines, cocaine, heroin, opioids, marijuana, prescription drugs, and synthetic drugs. We also provide personalized treatment for co-occurring disorders.

about_blocks.text: Irving House Addiction Treatment Centre is a premier rehab center located in the serene surroundings of Pembroke, Ontario. The center is designed specifically to meet the needs of male clients struggling with addiction issues. The facility’s exclusive program is built to provide a quiet and distraction-free environment, allowing clients to focus solely on their recovery.

about_blocks.text: The center offers a wide range of family services, making it an excellent choice for individuals who value openness and communication with their loved ones. Irving House provides evidence-based practices, holistic therapy, yoga, meditation, individual, family and group counseling, nutritional counseling, and art and nature therapy. With a well-trained and experienced team of professionals, clients at Irving House can expect to receive personalized treatment that suits their needs. The facility operates on a fee-for-service basis, giving clients the financial flexibility required to receive treatment without worrying about insurance coverage.
